conditions: Rank it to 30 for the Mastery; the Boltace recipe consumes a Boltor, so rank first.

disclosures.title: Junction tasks
disclosures.body: Vox Solaris, buying a Rhino blueprint from the Market for credits, starting a Rhino component in the Foundry, and defeating Jackal at Fossa. The Junction ends with the Volt Specter fight.

disclosures.title: Market craft instead
disclosures.body: Blueprint 15,000 cr from the Market. Build 24h: 25,000 cr, 2 Neurodes, 100 Alloy Plate, 900 Salvage, 600 Polymer Bundle. Strictly worse than the Junction reward, which comes catalyzed with a free slot.
